questions.q: The ______ of the new branch has been postponed until next year.
questions.exp: The 和 of 中間、後面沒有名詞，空格要名詞；opening（開幕）在這裡當名詞用。openly 是副詞，opened 是動詞變化，openable 是形容詞。

questions.q: The training session was ______ useful for new employees.
questions.exp: was 後面的 useful 已經是形容詞補語，空格修飾形容詞 useful，要副詞 extremely。

questions.q: 下面哪個 -ly 結尾的字是形容詞，不能拿來修飾動詞？
questions.exp: costly（昂貴的）是 -ly 結尾的形容詞；其他三個都是形容詞加 -ly 變成的副詞。

questions.q: Production costs ______ by eight percent last year.
questions.exp: 空格後面沒有受詞，要不及物的 rise，過去式 rose；raise 是及物，要說提高了什麼。

questions.q: 哪一句的及物動詞用法正確？
opts: We will discuss the budget on Monday.
We will discuss about the budget on Monday.
The budget will arrive the office on Monday.
questions.exp: discuss 是及物動詞，直接接受詞，不加 about；arrive、rise 是不及物，不能直接接受詞。

questions.q: The client seemed ______ after the product demonstration.
questions.exp: seem 是連綴動詞，後面接說明主詞的形容詞（補語），不接副詞。

questions.q: Our assistant booked ______ a table at the restaurant near the station.
questions.exp: book＋人＋東西（S＋V＋O＋O），人放前面時直接用受詞 us；要加 for 就要把人移到東西後面。

questions.q: The new scheduling software has made our weekly meetings much ______.
questions.exp: make＋受詞＋受詞補語（S＋V＋O＋C），說明會議變成什麼樣子，要形容詞 shorter；shortly 是「不久之後」的副詞。

questions.q: The report on customer complaints ______ on the manager's desk.
questions.exp: 主詞是 report（單數），on customer complaints 只是修飾；先找主詞再決定動詞，用 is。原形 be 不是有時態的動詞。

opts: The director read the proposal and approved it.
The director read the proposal approved it.
The director reading the proposal and approved it.
The director to read the proposal approved it.
questions.exp: 同一個主詞做兩個動作時，兩個有時態的動詞不能直接並排，中間要有 and 這類連接詞；reading、to read 不是有時態的動詞，不能當句子的主要動詞。
